 Logitech Black Friday Amazon sale now live: Nearly 50% off Mac accessories with deals from just $9
 Karthik Iyer  | Nov 19 2026 - 4:35 am PT 
 0 Comments 
 Nearly 50% off / From $9 
 Amazon’s Black Friday Week sale is bringing some notable discounts on Logitech mice, keyboards, webcams, and other desktop accessories , saving nearly 50% across select models. One of the biggest highlights is Logitech’s MX Creative 9-key Console, which has hit a new all-time low at $159.99 shipped . There are plenty of other deals to check out across the brand’s popular MX productivity lineup and creator accessories with prices starting at just $9 , and we’ve featured some particularly notable price drops from the sale below.
 Shop the Full Amazon Sale 
 Logitech MX Master 4
 $105 (Reg. $120) – Amazon low 
 Logitech’s MX Master 4 features customizable haptic feedback, MagSpeed scrolling, ergonomic design, and Actions Ring shortcuts for a smoother workflow.
 Logitech MX Creative 9-key Console
 $160 (Reg. $200) – All-time low 
 Logitech’s MX Creative Console features nine customizable LCD keys, giving creators quick access to shortcuts, tools, and controls across creative apps.
 Logitech Alto Keys K98M Keyboard
 $95 (Reg. $120) 
 Logitech’s Alto Keys K98M mechanical keyboard features a compact 98-key layout, customizable lighting, and a sleek off-white design for everyday typing.
